career_ladder.note: Tradesman Mate is a civilian industrial Group 'C' post in the Indian Navy (Ministry of Defence). Personnel work in Naval Dockyards (Mumbai, Visakhapatnam), Naval Ship Repair Yards (Kochi, Karwar), and Naval Armament Depots, assisting skilled technicians in ship refit, production, maintenance, and workshop operations. Progression follows the Ministry of Defence 4-tier industrial artisan hierarchy up to Master Craftsman and Foreman.

exam_scheme.note: Indian Navy Civilian Entrance Test (INCET) for Tradesman Mate consists of a single-stage Computer Based Examination (CBT) of 100 objective type MCQs (100 marks, 90 minutes) bilingual in English and Hindi, followed by Document Verification and Pre-Appointment Medical Examination.

financial_package.note: Tradesman Mate in the Indian Navy is placed in Central Civil Services Pay Matrix Level 1 (₹18,000 – ₹56,900). In addition to basic pay and central DA, dockyard and depot employees are entitled to House Rent Allowance, Transport Allowance, Overtime Allowance (OTA) under the Factories Act for workshop overtime shifts, Productivity Linked Bonus (PLB), and CSD canteen access.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Indian Navy — INCET-01/2023 Recruitment Notice (Scale of Pay & Allowances)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 1 entry basic pay of ₹18,000: Dearness Allowance @ 58% is ₹10,440; HRA ranges from 10% (₹1,800 in Z class) to 30% (₹5,400 in X class metro such as Mumbai / Visakhapatnam naval commands); Transport Allowance is ₹1,350 + DA (₹2,133). Gross monthly pay spans ₹33,000 to ₹40,000 (excluding overtime). In-hand pay after 10% NPS deduction (₹2,844) is approximately ₹28,000 to ₹35,000.
official_perks: CSD Canteen smart card purchasing facilities for defence civilian personnel
Naval Dockyard Health Clinic / Dispensary and CGHS hospital coverage
Productivity Linked Bonus (PLB) equivalent to 40 days wages paid annually before festive season
Overtime Allowance (OTA) under Factories Act, 1948 for operational docking and refit shifts
Government residential quarters in naval civilian colonies or central HRA
Children Education Allowance (CEA) of ₹2,250 per month per child and LTC entitlements
